{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in the revenue column
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many rows have commas
num_with_commas = has_commas.sum()

print(f"Number of rows with commas in 'revenue': {num_with_commas}")
print(f"Proportion with commas: {num_with_commas / len(sales):.2%}")

# Show a few examples of rows with commas if any
if num_with_commas > 0:
    print("Examples with commas:")
    print(sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head().tolist())"}
